sentences.text: Your records contain 15 source reports dating from 22 Apr 1952 to 11 Jun 2021 for a 71-year-old male.
Your records list diabetes, hypertriglyceridemia, metabolic syndrome X, anemia, diabetic retinopathy associated with type II diabetes mellitus, and neuropathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus.
Your records also list nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus, hyperlipidemia, and macular edema and retinopathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus.
Your records list a previous diagnosis of viral sinusitis that was recorded on 24 Oct 2019 and resolved on 16 Nov 2019.
For LDL cholesterol (often called 'bad' cholesterol), your latest result on 11 Jun 2021 was 153 mg/dL, which is above the usual range of below 100 mg/dL.
Over the last 3 reports, LDL cholesterol changed from 128.5 to 126.3 and then 153 mg/dL.
For SGPT (a liver enzyme), your latest result on 15 Apr 2021 was 59.6 U/L, which is above the usual range of 7 to 40 U/L.
Over the last 3 reports, SGPT changed from 24.4 to 34.7 and then 59.6 U/L.
For triglycerides (a type of blood fat), your latest result on 11 Jun 2021 was 196.5 mg/dL, which is above the usual range of below 150 mg/dL.
Over the last 3 reports, triglycerides changed from 187.6 to 131.4 and then 196.5 mg/dL.
For HbA1c (average blood sugar over the last few months), your latest result on 11 Jun 2021 was 7 %, which is above the usual range of 4 to 5.6 %.
Over the last 3 reports, HbA1c changed from 7 to 7 and then 7 %.
For total cholesterol, your latest result on 11 Jun 2021 was 237.5 mg/dL, which is above the usual range of below 200 mg/dL.
Over the last 3 reports, total cholesterol changed from 213.7 to 173.4 and then 237.5 mg/dL.
For blood sugar (glucose), your latest result on 11 Jun 2021 was 100.2 mg/dL, which is above the usual range of 70 to 99 mg/dL.
Over the last 3 reports, blood sugar (glucose) changed from 105.7 to 109.1 and then 100.2 mg/dL.
The other test results in your records did not raise an alert.
Your latest blood pressure reading on 11 Jun 2021 was 110/84, which is below 140/90.
Your haemoglobin is 15.7 g/dL, which is at or above 13 g/dL.
Your records list ongoing medications including Simvastatin 10 MG Oral Tablet, Fluticasone propionate 0.044 MG/ACTUAT Metered Dose Inhaler, and Albuterol 0.09 MG/ACTUAT Metered Dose Inhaler.
No allergies are recorded in the supplied records.

sections.title: Points to discuss with your doctor

sentences.text: You can ask your doctor about your latest test results that are outside the usual ranges and what steps you can take for your overall health.
